messages.author: Matthew Guberman-Pfeffer
messages.body:
Dear Amber Community,
I was asked to install amber on a collaborator’s computer that has not been updated from Ubuntu 14. 04.2. That’s so old I don’t see instructions on the Amber website (
https://ambermd.org/InstUbuntu.php
) for what to do. Short of installing a newer version of Ubuntu, is there an old set of libraries and old version of amber I can install? Only plane ‘vanilla’ MD needs to be run.
Best,
Matthew

messages.author: David A Case
